items.example: I like travelling by train because it's more comfortable.
items.mnemonic: Тревель-блогер like travelling by train — любить путешествовать поездом.

items.phrase: prefer doing something to doing something else
items.example: I prefer relaxing on a beach to going sightseeing.
items.mnemonic: Профессор prefer relaxing to sightseeing — предпочитать пляж экскурсиям.

items.example: I like going on holiday in autumn.
items.mnemonic: С холодцом go on holiday — ездить в отпуск.

items.phrase: a weekend / a week / a month
items.example: My perfect holiday is a week by the sea.
items.mnemonic: Викенд у моря: a week by the sea — неделю у моря.

items.example: She is good at languages and travels a lot.
items.mnemonic: Гудок хвалит: be good at languages — быть хорошим в языках.

items.example: Are you a good travel partner? — Why/Why not?
items.mnemonic: Партия путешественников: be a good travel partner — быть хорошим попутчиком.

items.phrase: which one do you like more?
items.translation: какой из них тебе нравится больше?
items.example: Which city do you like more, Kraków or Warsaw?
items.mnemonic: Турист жмёт лайк: which one do you like more — какой нравится больше.

items.example: This hotel is easy to find; that one is difficult to find.
items.mnemonic: Отель с изюмом be easier to find — быть проще найти.

items.example: Art galleries are more expensive than museums.
items.mnemonic: Галера с картинами: an art gallery — картинная галерея.

items.example: An e-book is as good as a paper book.
items.mnemonic: Азбука сравнивает as good as — так же хорош как.

items.example: Hotels in the centre are more expensive.
items.mnemonic: Цирк in the centre — в центре.

items.example: We drove across the countryside for three hours.
